commands.author: steipete

target.title: Add Cursor and filter widget provider options
target.body:
## Summary

- Add Cursor to configurable and interactive CodexBar widgets.
- Filter provider choices to widget-capable providers enabled in CodexBar settings, preserving settings order.
- Default new widgets to the first enabled supported provider, with a Codex fallback only when WidgetKit needs a valid choice.
- Keep persisted widget selections stable while preventing disabled providers from rendering retained usage data.
- Label legacy Cursor request quotas as `Requests`; label current Cursor quota rows as `Total`, `Auto`, and `API`.
- Add focused regression coverage and document the provider-choice, fallback, and disabled-state contracts.

Fixes #2040.

## Foundation

This keeps the existing widget snapshot and App Intents architecture:

- `ProviderChoice` remains the stable enum persisted by widget configurations.
- `EnabledProviderOptionsProvider` derives dynamic choices from `WidgetSnapshot.enabledProviders`.
- Unsupported providers are omitted through the existing `UsageProvider` to `ProviderChoice` mapping.
- `WidgetSnapshot.enabledEntry(for:)` is the shared eligibility gate for Usage, History, Metric, Switcher, and Burn Down surfaces, so retained entries remain available for re-enabling without leaking stale data while disabled.
- Before the first snapshot exists, all widget-capable providers remain available; if no enabled provider supports widgets, Codex is the configuration fallback.

## Verification

Exact candidate: `b45ccc21e5b3a46889c66c86c2913c9397ea2581`

- `swift test --filter WidgetSnapshotTests` — 21 tests passed across 3 suites.
- `swift test --filter CodexBarWidgetProviderTests` — 50 tests passed.
- `make check` — SwiftFormat and SwiftLint clean.
- `make test` — 601/601 selections passed across 51/51 groups; zero failures, retries, or timeouts.
- Structured review and source-blind behavior validation — clean/pass.
- Signed debug app and widget — strict code-sign verification passed; Gatekeeper accepted the Developer ID build.
- Live macOS 27 beta gallery — exact-head extension rendered Cursor before z.ai and showed `Total`, `Auto`, and `API` in small, medium, and large previews.
- Live placed-widget checks — small and medium switchers fit both provider chips plus all three quota rows; selection persisted across an exact extension-process restart.
- Live state checks — an all-disabled snapshot rendered the empty fallback instead of retained Cursor/Codex data; a legacy snapshot rendered `Requests` in every supported preview size.

Live screenshots were retained locally for verification and were not uploaded.

Thanks @Zihao-Qi for the contribution.
